headerSubtitle: Step-by-step capital deployment into 4 core national pillars ($5B per step)

automation_production_lines.name: Industrial Automation & Factory Yield

automation_production_lines.description: Equipping assembly lines with robotics and automated AI engineering, permanently raising factory outputs by 10%, 20%, and 35% at Steps 10, 20, and 30.

logistics_procurement_modernization.name: Force Procurement & Supply Lines

logistics_procurement_modernization.description: Standardized military arsenals and modular manufacturing, lowering recruitment costs for infantry, armor, air defense, jets, and missiles by 10%, 20%, and 30% at Steps 10, 20, and 30.

combat_command_supremacy.name: Battlefield Command & Firepower
